label: Bible Study
prompt: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man _____, let him come unto me, and drink.
verse: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
note: Shouted on the last great day of the feast — an open invitation to come and drink.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the _____ of God.
verse: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.
note: Eating, drinking and enjoying your work — the Preacher calls it the gift of God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe _____, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.
verse: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.
note: Nathan's parable of the poor man's one little ewe lamb — the story that trapped a king into judging himself.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and _____ to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.
verse: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.
note: Ezra hearing of Israel's intermarriage with idolaters tore his clothes and prayed red-faced.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my _____, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
verse: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
note: David stacks up names for God in one breath — rock, fortress, deliverer, high tower — and 'buckler,' a small round shield.
